sanskrit:
अधिभूतं क्षरो भावः पुरुषश्चाधिदैवतम् ।
अधियज्ञोऽहमेवात्र देहे देहभृतां वर ॥ ८-४॥
iast:
adhibhūtaṃ kṣaro bhāvaḥ puruṣaścādhidaivatam
adhiyajño’hamevātra dehe dehabhṛtāṃ vara 8-4
translation: ADHIBHUTA (or elements) constitutes My perishable nature, and the Indweller (or the essence) is the ADHIDAIVATA; I alone am the ADHIYAJNA here, in this body, O best of the embodied.
